newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU should maximise cheese exports.
newsitem.headline: EU should maximise cheese exports.

text.p: Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler told European Union farm ministers on Wednesday that cheese export subsidies should be maximised by concentrating on hard cheeses, an EU member state official said.
"The Commissioner said that export subsidies are limited under World Trade Organisation (WTO) rules and that the EU should be exporting dry matter not water," the official said.
Austria, supported by Ireland and Italy, had complained that a reduction in export refunds had harmed exports to the United States.
The United Kingdom said it was concerned that the refund policy benefited some cheeses and not others.
Fischler said that there had been increased demand for licences.
The Council suggested that the Commmission should draw up a stricter definition of cheeses eligible for export refunds, the official said.
